      <h1>FishInTrait</h1>
      <p class="tagline">Field-campaign management for fish trait digitization — photographs, specimens, provenance.</p>
      <div class="badges"><span class="badge-pill orange"><span>version</span><span>in development</span></span><span class="badge-pill grey"><span>R</span><span>≥ 4.1.0</span></span><span class="badge-pill grey"><span>license</span><span>GPL-3</span></span></div>

  <div class="pkg-layout">
    <div class="pkg-main">

      <h2>Overview</h2>
      <p><code>FishInTrait</code> is the field-campaign side of the toolkit: it organises a digitization
      <strong>campaign</strong> — the photographs of a survey, their import into a project folder, the specimens and
      their determinations — and hands the resulting measurements to <a href="Rpackages_intraitr.html">intraitR</a>
      (analysis) and <a href="Rpackages_rfishmorph.html">Rfishmorph</a> (FISHMORPH database). It keeps a
      <strong>campaign journal</strong> (record, specimen, field, value) from which the provenance of every photograph
      can be recovered, and provides a Shiny explorer of the campaign, including an <em>Absent from FISHMORPH</em> view
      for species that still need to be added to the database.</p>

      <div class="callout warn">
        <strong>Documentation in preparation.</strong> This page will be completed from the package's
        <code>DESCRIPTION</code>, README and reference index once the repository is published.
      </div>

      <h2>Project layout</h2>
      <p>A FishInTrait project is a folder with a fixed layout, auto-detected by the companion packages:</p>
<pre><code>&lt;project&gt;/
├── photos/            # specimen photographs (stay local)
├── measurements/      # landmark workbooks (.xlsx) read by intraitR
└── journal/           # append-only import journals (provenance)</code></pre>
      <p><code>intraitR::read_landmarks_xlsx()</code> reads the provenance keys of this layout automatically, so that
      a workbook keeps the link to the original photograph of each specimen even after files are renamed.</p>

      <h2>How the three packages fit together</h2>
      <div class="flow">
        <div class="flow-box"><b>FishInTrait</b>campaign, photographs, provenance</div>
        <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
        <div class="flow-box"><b>intraitR</b>landmarks → traits → ITV &amp; error</div>
        <div class="flow-arrow">→</div>
        <div class="flow-box"><b>Rfishmorph</b>FISHMORPH scheme, space &amp; database</div>
      </div>

      <h2>Main functions</h2>
      <table class="fn-table">
        <tr><th>Family</th><th>Functions</th></tr>
        <tr><td>Exploration</td><td><code>launch_fishintrait_explorer()</code> — Shiny explorer of a campaign (specimens, determinations, species absent from FISHMORPH)</td></tr>
        <tr><td>Journal</td><td>campaign import journal (<code>record_id</code>, <code>timestamp</code>, <code>operator</code>, <code>app_version</code>, <code>action</code>, <code>specimen</code>, <code>field</code>, <code>value</code>)</td></tr>
      </table>

<script>
const CORRECT_HASH = "ac95cc34e3ff9d4e59fd3066f6feaee0d2f4f7f97d3865148bc5767834883ff5";

async function sha256(msg) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}

function unlock() {
  document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("pkg-content").style.display = "block";
  sessionStorage.setItem("rpackages_unlocked", "1");
}

async function checkPw() {
  const hash = await sha256(document.getElementById("pw-input").value);
  if (hash === CORRECT_HASH) {
    unlock();
  } else {
    const err = document.getElementById("pw-error");
    err.textContent = "Incorrect password. Please try again.";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").value = "";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").focus();
    setTimeout(() => { err.textContent = ""; }, 3000);
  }
}

if (sessionStorage.getItem("rpackages_unlocked") === "1" ||
    sessionStorage.getItem("rscripts_unlocked") === "1") {
  unlock();
}

</script>
